customManagers.description: Generic across every image in this monorepo, not just one - a matrix entry's own tag isn't a package manager Renovate recognizes, so any context whose published tag is meant to track an upstream base image opts in the same way: a `# renovate: depName=...` comment (same convention as m11s/kubernetes/registry) directly above its matrix entry in build.yaml. Each Dockerfile's own FROM/ARG line is already tracked separately by Renovate's default dockerfile manager - this just keeps the matrix tag string in lockstep with it.
